statement: The project lead needs repeatable measured hop data from a reduced-gravity analogue to compare locomotion concepts.
rationale: Mission need for Phase 1 concept selection
acceptance_criteria: Project lead confirms the trial data set supports concept comparison (MOE-1: range 1-sigma spread <= 10 % over 10 trials)
notes: Hypothesis until validated with the stakeholder

statement: The mission architect needs relocation hops that cannot lose the robot from the target body.
rationale: Loss of vehicle ends the mission
acceptance_criteria: Architect confirms analysed launch speeds <= 30 % of circular-orbit speed (MOE-2)
notes: Hypothesis until validated with the stakeholder

statement: The safety authority needs ground trials to run without exposing people to stored mechanical energy.
acceptance_criteria: 0 operator entries into the guarded zone while energy is stored over 20 trials (MOE-3)
notes: Hypothesis until validated with the stakeholder

statement: The mission architect needs the robot to come to rest after landing within a bounded wait.
rationale: Work cannot resume while the robot is bouncing
acceptance_criteria: Architect confirms predicted settle time <= 2400 s for restitution up to 0.8 (MOE-4)
notes: Hypothesis until validated with the stakeholder

statement: The locomotion system shall limit hop launch speed relative to the local surface to 0.085 m/s (TBR) or less.
rationale: 0.085 m/s is 28.4 % of circular-orbit speed 0.2991 m/s and 20.1 % of escape speed 0.4230 m/s on ASTER-T1 (synthetic); keeps the flat-gravity hop model inside the 30 % heuristic
source: lowg_calc.py outputs/04b-lowg-sizing.json cases ASTER-T1-BODY and HOP-MAX
acceptance_criteria: lowg_calc.py analysis of every commanded hop case shows launch speed <= 0.085 m/s and no exceeds-orbital-speed or exceeds-escape-speed finding
notes: TBR closes when a real target body is chosen (Q2); owner mission systems architect

statement: The locomotion system shall relocate the robot by at least 10 m (TBR) per hop on ASTER-T1 at launch speeds within the ASTER-SYS-001 limit.
rationale: HOP-NOM gives 13.2 m range at 0.05 m/s and HOP-MAX 38.1 m at 0.085 m/s (45 deg, net equatorial gravity 1.898e-4 m/s2); 10 m is the assumed minimum site spacing
source: lowg_calc.py outputs/04b-lowg-sizing.json cases HOP-NOM and HOP-MAX
acceptance_criteria: Predicted range >= 10 m at a launch speed <= 0.085 m/s with range <= 10 % of body radius (40 m)

statement: The locomotion system shall come to rest with body speed below 0.005 m/s within 2400 s (TBR) of first landing contact for landing speeds perpendicular to the surface of up to 0.06 m/s.
rationale: Bounce analysis at 0.06 m/s impact: restitution 0.2 settles in 126 s, 0.5 in 553 s, 0.8 in 2312 s; restitution is unknown so the bound covers 0.2-0.8
source: lowg_calc.py outputs/04b-lowg-sizing.json cases BNC-LOW-E BNC-MID-E BNC-HIGH-E
acceptance_criteria: Predicted settle time <= 2400 s for restitution 0.2 0.5 and 0.8
notes: Landing normal speed 0.06 m/s = vertical component of HOP-MAX

statement: The ground demonstrator shall record commanded actuation time and body acceleration at a sampling rate of 200 Hz (TBR) or more.
rationale: A 0.2 s take-off push (IMP-MAX push time) then yields at least 40 samples; carried forward from starter requirement ASTER01-REQ-001
source: Starter register ASTER01-REQ-001; lowg_calc.py case IMP-MAX
acceptance_criteria: Logged sample interval <= 5.0 ms for 3 consecutive trials with command timestamps present in every record

statement: The test rig shall remove actuator power within 0.5 s (TBR) of emergency-stop activation.
rationale: Limits release of stored energy during a fault; carried forward from starter requirement ASTER01-REQ-002; value to be confirmed by the safety authority
source: Starter register ASTER01-REQ-002; preliminary hazard list in risk-register.csv
acceptance_criteria: Measured power-removal latency <= 0.5 s in 10 of 10 activations witnessed by an independent observer
notes: Safety requirement: owner is the safety authority

statement: The ground demonstrator shall reduce stored actuator energy to below 0.1 J (TBR) within 60 s of a safing command.
rationale: Launch kinetic energy at the speed limit is 0.043 J (IMP-MAX); a spring with an assumed 30 % transfer efficiency stores about 0.15 J and a flywheel stores more, so stored energy must be dumped before approach
source: lowg_calc.py case IMP-MAX; engineering estimate of transfer efficiency (TBR)
acceptance_criteria: Measured residual stored energy < 0.1 J within 60 s of the safing command in 10 of 10 trials

statement: The offload rig shall limit residual effective vertical acceleration of the demonstrator to 0.1 m/s2 (TBR) or less.
rationale: ASTER-T1 net gravity 1.9e-4 m/s2 cannot be reproduced by a counterweight rig; 0.1 m/s2 is a placeholder until rig friction and inertia are characterised (ConOps Q1)
source: ConOps open question Q1; lowg_calc.py case ASTER-T1-BODY
acceptance_criteria: Measured residual vertical acceleration <= 0.1 m/s2 averaged over 1 s in 5 calibration drops

statement: The test rig shall arrest uncontrolled demonstrator or counterweight motion within 0.3 m (TBR) of travel.
rationale: Bounds counterweight runaway and cable-snag hazards (ConOps S6)
acceptance_criteria: Measured arrest distance <= 0.3 m in 5 of 5 induced cable-release trials with an inert mass

statement: The hop controller software shall inhibit actuator release when the estimated launch speed exceeds 0.085 m/s (TBR).
acceptance_criteria: Software-in-the-loop: 0 releases in 50 injected over-speed commands; release in 50 of 50 commands <= 0.085 m/s

statement: The hop actuator shall deliver a take-off impulse between 0.30 N s and 1.02 N s (TBR) for a 12 kg (TBR) robot.
rationale: 1.02 N s = 12 kg x 0.085 m/s (IMP-MAX); 0.30 N s gives 0.025 m/s for short repositioning hops
acceptance_criteria: Bench load-cell impulse within 0.30-1.02 N s +/- 5 % across 10 firings at minimum and maximum settings
notes: Robot mass 12 kg is a proposed value

statement: The data logger shall timestamp samples with a resolution of 1 ms or finer.
rationale: Aligns command and acceleration records within one 5 ms sample
acceptance_criteria: Timestamp increments <= 1 ms observed in a 60 s bench recording

statement: The emergency-stop chain shall open the actuator power contactor through hardwired logic independent of the controller software.
rationale: A software fault must not defeat the emergency stop
acceptance_criteria: Schematic inspection shows no software-controlled element between e-stop button and contactor coil
